posts.title: Introducing Wikiwandrr – Wikipedia reading, organised
posts.description: Wikiwandrr is an elegant and accessible browser for Wikipedia™ that tracks the articles you read and organises them (as well as the ones you want to read later) into beautiful hierarchical lists and sessions. For students, researchers, and curious minds alike, Wikiwandrr transforms the way you browse knowledge. Instead of getting lost in endless tabs, […]
